summary: Keep disk-selection explanations visible at 800×600 (BUG-0153). API impact: none; installer text formatting changes no API.

guide.reason: Existing selection, review and explicit erase-confirmation steps are unchanged; this restores visibility of existing explanations.

api.reason: API impact: none. Native installer label formatting has no Controller operation, Core command, observed-state flow or client-facing API change.

roadmap.reason: Presentation correction only; production acceptance remains open.

state.reason: No durable state or setting is introduced.

verification.method: Actual seventh-ISO native regression failed on clipped text. Eighth-ISO rendering fixed both labels; an initial incorrect screenshot coordinate failed and was retained. The corrected locator was independently reviewed against actual pre/post captures. Full native wizard checks then passed at 800×600 and 1024×768, with direct ISO-extracted kernel/initrd, a preparation-observation marker, new disposable file disks, visible target review and unchecked erase refusal. Root inspected captures. Installer-disk, installer-check, Python compilation and privacy checks passed. Both CI providers run existing suites; hosted CI and eighth-ISO full installation remain unexecuted.
